status: Frozen before any ABIDE-II model fitting, prediction, or score inspection.
purpose: Determine whether ABIDE-II can support a prospective external evaluation compatible with the frozen ABIDE-I representation.

pass_requires: An official or fully documented derivative maps unambiguously to the main ABIDE-II phenotype records.
The derivative supplies 116-column AAL time series in a documented orientation.
Filtering, global-signal treatment, nuisance regression, registration, censoring, and temporal units are documented well enough to compare with Study 1.
Technical quality checks can be applied without using diagnosis or model outcomes to choose exclusions.
The longitudinal ABIDE-I participants are excluded from the independent external cohort.
No ABIDE-II label or score is used for model selection, preprocessing selection, checkpoint selection, or tuning.
decision_rule.failure_action: Do not construct predictions. Record the incompatibility and keep ABIDE-II outside the completed findings.
